messages:
nina: Heads-up: support reported billing mismatch. Example: runtime consumed 'tenant-pro' but console shows 'default'. No x-route-hint in request.
marie: Likely fallout from removing auto route hints in SDKs. We need quick mitigation.
aditya: Quick plan: runtime will emit X-Resolved-Route on responses (guarded behind feature flag). Console ingestion will use that when present.
sam: SDKs should NOT change default yet. Ship a patch that emits a sampled telemetry event when route hint is absent and a DEBUG log.
console-bot: Ticket created: CONSOLE-674 (ingest resolved-route).
aditya: I'll open a runtime PR with feature flag and stream-first-chunk metadata for streaming clients.
marie: Devex: add CLI `--send-route-hint` snippet and a short support blurb.
sam: Timeline: runtime canary in 48h, console ingest + dashboard tile in 72h, SDK telemetry patch tomorrow. Re-evaluate after 10 days.
aditya: Deploy queued: deploy/canary/runtime/emit-resolved-route. ETA ~1h.
marie: Thanks. Keep the channel updated with canary metrics.
